copyright_policy: Public file contains original structural annotations and EMPTY verbatim dialogue slots. Only publish quoted dialogue when permission or another appropriate basis has been established.

transcription_policy.goal: Exhaustive transcript: every spoken, written, and background line, all on-screen prompts/options, player-selected spoken replies, alternative branches, ambient action, QTEs, timeouts, and state changes.
transcription_policy.insert_spoken_lines_as: speech events in chronological order, including NPC chatter between choice prompts
transcription_policy.every_choice_requires: exact text for each visible option, including silence/time-out, in the observed order
transcription_policy.branch_model: option-specific branch_timeline, followed by shared chronology; never mix mutually exclusive reactions
transcription_policy.distinguish: screen_text is what user chooses; branch_timeline speech is what the character actually says
transcription_policy.never_guess: null/pending means untranscribed, not silent; do not show as verified
transcription_policy.source_rights: Transcript references are research pointers, not permission to republish scripts.
